name: io.github.jeanpfs/stock-images-mcp
title: Stock Images MCP
description: Search and download free stock images from Pexels, Unsplash, and Pixabay.

environmentVariables.name: PEXELS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from pexels.com/api (free). At least one provider key is required.

environmentVariables.name: UNSPLASH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access key from unsplash.com/developers (free). Required to download Unsplash photos.
